messages.subject: Error in spectro function
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I am getting this error:

Error in specprop(spec(song, f = 44100)) : 
  Frequency resolution is too high (<0.5 hz)

which seems to refer to the sampling frequency used during recording process. Are there any possibility of transforming the original files sampled at 44.1 kHz to other rate before run the script? 

Any idea about?

Thanks in advance

M

messages.author: d91178de15999ecf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Error in spectro function
parts:
Checkout the downsample() function from the tuneR package. Also, if it's frequency resolution that's the problem you could consider adjusting the wavelength argument (wl) in the spec function. Simply put, increasing wavelength increases the frequency resolution at the cost of temporal resolution and vice versa.

But I'm not sure which would be the better route to take in this case. Good luck!

Steffi
